title: BMC host is not among the duthosts when running the tests
author: nikamirrr
body:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/365db900d007e036de9c994176cbb00ef4901b61/tests/common/devices/multi_asic.py#L384

- BMC host is not the dut, because the BMC is the dut, they are not the same
- The test code randomly selectes the host from the duthosts, so BMC host cannot be added there.
- Need to create the MultiAsicSonicHost instance in place to return

### Description of PR
This PR fixes get_bmc_host that fails to lookup the bmc_host in the duthosts.
Instead it needs it initialize it specifically

Summary:
Instead of looking up the duthosts it initializes the MultiAsicSonicHost instance

Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/25790
